observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== endpoints summary ===" && for ep in /health /api /api-json /v2/topics /metrics; do printf "%-12s " "$ep"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:3000$ep"; done; echo "=== pgadmin ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5050/; echo "=== DB table count in ga ==="; docker exec geospatialanalyzer-postgres-dev psql -U postgres -d postgres -t -c "SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='ga';"
